records.alignment_scope: 0 for both horizontal and stacked/vertical compositions
usage_rules: Default stacked brand signature for covers, formal pages, profile pages and centered layouts.
Use this complete SVG as a locked artwork unit; do not reconstruct from separate seal and text geometry.
Allow proportional scaling and positioning only; never stretch, crop, recolour outside the approved colour variant, perspective-warp, trace, smooth or retypeset.
Respect the embedded clearspace and minimum size. If the space cannot hold an approved lockup, use another approved variant or flag the constraint.
Image models may generate backgrounds only; composite this exact SVG afterward and record canonical_lockup_id, canonical_lockup_sha256 and canonical_seal_sha256.
Bilingual lockup uses the shared 881-unit three-line measure.
contrast_caveats: Red apostrophe on dark background is intentionally retained from approval; use monochrome only when a one-colour high-contrast signature is required.
Fine English line depends on normal antialiasing at minimum size; do not disable antialiasing or shrink below minimum.

records.alignment_scope: 0 for both horizontal and stacked/vertical compositions
usage_rules: Default complete canonical logo for everyday digital and horizontal layouts, including small digital placements; scale as one SVG without altering its seal-to-lettering ratio.
Use this complete SVG as a locked artwork unit; do not reconstruct from separate seal and text geometry.
Allow proportional scaling and positioning only; never stretch, crop, recolour outside the approved colour variant, perspective-warp, trace, smooth or retypeset.

On screens, prefer 360–480 px. When necessary scale whole SVG down proportionally to 320 px; inspect fine English line at actual output size. Below 320 px use V-01 seal alone. For print keep conservative 110 mm minimum.
Image models may generate backgrounds only; composite this exact SVG afterward and record canonical_lockup_id, canonical_lockup_sha256 and canonical_seal_sha256.
Bilingual lockup uses the shared 881-unit three-line measure.
contrast_caveats: Red apostrophe on dark background is intentionally retained from approval; use monochrome only when a one-colour high-contrast signature is required.
Fine English line may soften at 320–359 px; inspect real-size raster and reject illegible placements, never substitute retired C-03/D-04.
